name: AWS IAM — Managed Policies
description: Pull customer-managed IAM policies as cloud entitlements for CIEM permission analysis

steps.instruction: Log into the AWS Management Console and go to IAM → Users
Create or select an IAM user and attach the IAMReadOnlyAccess managed policy
Go to Security credentials → Create access key → Choose 'Third-party service'
IAM is global. Provide a region for SigV4 signing.

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to AWS IAM. Verify your access key has IAMReadOnlyAccess permission.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'entitlement_type': 'iam_policy', 'policy_name': record.get('PolicyName', ''), 'policy_id': record.get('PolicyId', ''), 'arn': record.get('Arn', ''), 'account_id': (str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')[4] if record.get('Arn') and len(str(record.get('Arn', '')).split(':')) > 4 else ''), 'display_name': record.get('PolicyName', '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'resource_type': 'iam_policy', 'entitlement_kind': 'permission_set', 'path': record.get('Path', '/'), 'description': record.get('Description', ''), 'attachment_count': int(record.get('AttachmentCount', 0)) if record.get('AttachmentCount') is not None else 0, 'permissions_boundary_usage_count': int(record.get('PermissionsBoundaryUsageCount', 0)) if record.get('PermissionsBoundaryUsageCount') is not None else 0, 'is_attachable': record.get('IsAttachable', 'true') in ('true', True, 'True'), 'default_version_id': record.get('DefaultVersionId', ''), 'create_date': record.get('CreateDate', ''), 'update_date': record.get('UpdateDate', '')}

region.description: AWS region for SigV4 signing (IAM is a global service)
